title: Check 784 pixels and fit centroids inside each fold
summary: Compare raw-pixel nearest-class centroids with one per-image L2 change under a bounded CPU workflow. The original 200 geometric patterns are not real handwritten digits.
environment: Recorded with Python 3.12.14 and its standard library only on Darwin arm64. This local CPU run is the recorded environment; other environments are not covered by this receipt.
steps: Download and run with Python 3.12.14. The fixture needs no neural library, accelerator or account.
Check 784 pixels and labels 0–9. Compare raw nearest-class centroids with per-image L2 normalization on the same five stratified folds; class means fit training rows only.
Inspect fold results, blank-image behavior and the actual resource receipt. Explain why a high pattern-fixture score says nothing about handwriting recognition quality.

Optional: --csv authorized-train.csv --max-rows 1000 reads a bounded prefix. Use columns label,pixel0,...,pixel783 in order, finite 0–255 values and at least five rows per label. The generated CSV mode is tested; real competition images were not run.
limitations: Generated geometric patterns are not handwritten digits, MNIST or competition data.
A bounded prefix sample may be biased; no full competition dataset was run.
Per-image normalization and training-only centroids do not establish writer-held-out or shifted-image performance.
Mean fold accuracy is not a competition score or historical CNN reproduction.
Memory measures traced Python allocations, not process RSS.
split_definition: Five label-stratified folds with seed 17; each sampled row validates once; centroids fit training rows only; CSV uses a declared prefix cap.

project.outcome: Check 28 by 28 pixel layout and class coverage, fit class centroids inside training folds, and compare one per-image L2 change without treating generated patterns as handwriting.
prerequisites: Read 784 flattened pixels, integer labels 0–9, vector length, class means and fold accuracy; run the pinned Python script locally.

access.instructions: Use the generated teaching fixture with --fixture. Optional private inputs require your own authorized access; they have not been verified by this receipt.
access.authorization: Original generated teaching fixture distributed with the script; no competition files required.

project.baseline: Fit raw-centroids using training rows only on the fixed declared splits.
project.controlled_change: Compare image-l2-centroids on exactly the same splits; a worse metric is a valid outcome.
diagnostics: Inspect label counts and blank-image behavior before fitting; explain why every fold needs all ten classes.
Compare raw and L2-normalized centroid accuracy on every unchanged fold and explain why the pattern-fixture result does not establish writer-held-out performance.

troubleshooting.symptom: Wrong image shape, pixel range or label
troubleshooting.recovery: The validator requires exactly 784 finite pixel values in 0–255 and an integer label 0–9. Fix the authorized input format; do not pad, reshape or clip silently.

Use label,pixel0,...,pixel783 in that order and a declared prefix cap between 50 and 1000 with at least five rows of every digit. If the scope cannot meet this, stop and document a new sample before rerunning both methods.

troubleshooting.symptom: Blank image has zero L2 length
troubleshooting.recovery: Keep the script's zero-vector fallback; count blank images and inspect their effect without dividing by zero.
